text:
tessa: FYI opened a small PR to clarify APAC region display names and add a Go SDK snippet for region pinning. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/560 — tagging @raman @ian for copy + snippet review.
raman: I'll validate the copy, esp. the Hosted vs Dedicated wording around data residency. Some pages currently say 'processed in-region' which Legal might prefer.
ian: I'll add a Go snippet and sync JS/Python examples to use explicit 'region' field. Do we want full region codes (ap-southeast-1, ap-northeast-1) in the table?
tessa: Yes please use full region codes and human names (Singapore, Tokyo). Also remove short shorthands like 'sg' to avoid confusion.
legal-bot: Legal review: use canonical compliance link /compliance/data-residency/apac. Hosted API does NOT guarantee storage in-region; Dedicated and Private deployments are the ones where customer data are stored in-region (encrypted at rest, KMS-managed). Please mirror this exact phrasing.
link-bot: Link-checker: found outdated internal link -> /compliance/apac (docs/region-availability-apac.md). Recommended replacement: /compliance/data-residency/apac.
ian: Draft Go snippet (keeps minimal deps):
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("RW_API_KEY"))
resp, _ := client.Generate(context.Background(), redwood.GenerateParams{
  Model: "redwood-instruct-1",
  Input: "Summarize the new region table",
  Region: "ap-southeast-1",
})
fmt.Println(resp.Output)
```
raman: Snippet looks good. I'll update the APAC table rows, add the legal phrasing, and swap the link.
tessa: Thanks all 680 Pushed fixes and updated the table to show codes + names. Running docs CI now.
link-bot: CI: passed (docs-link-check).
tessa: Merged. If Legal opens follow-up I'll adjust, but this should be good for now.
